about: South Glengarry is a township in the United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry, Ontario, east of Cornwall along the St. Lawrence River—not a city. Villages such as Lancaster and Williamstown, Glengarry Highland heritage, and Seaway farmland share the riverside landscape toward the Quebec border. About 13,000 people live in South Glengarry Township.
